second_answer_attack.resolution: NPR2 loss can produce autosomal-dominant short stature, but it does not characteristically combine advanced bone age, premature growth cessation, and unusually early osteoarthritis. Those growth-plate and articular-cartilage findings are strongly associated with heterozygous ACAN variants.

blind_audit.rationale: ACAN encodes aggrecan, a major proteoglycan in growth-plate and articular-cartilage extracellular matrix. Heterozygous pathogenic variants can produce familial short stature with advanced bone age and early growth cessation; joint disease and early osteoarthritis may accompany the growth phenotype. Strongest alternative resolved: NPR2 loss can produce autosomal-dominant short stature, but it does not characteristically combine advanced bone age, premature growth cessation, and unusually early osteoarthritis. Those growth-plate and articular-cartilage findings are strongly associated with heterozygous ACAN variants.
